## Review verdict

**No major issues found at exact head `0041fbc901f3efa35a390c14271a6d9055b7f263`.**

The round-4 and round-5 repairs are present and internally consistent:

- Both keyed publication paths obtain durable terminal-state admission immediately before publishing. [polis/src/polis/pursuit/actions.pyL690-L703](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/0041fbc901f3efa35a390c14271a6d9055b7f263/polis/src/polis/pursuit/actions.py#L690-L703) [polis/src/polis/pursuit/actions.pyL768-L785](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/0041fbc901f3efa35a390c14271a6d9055b7f263/polis/src/polis/pursuit/actions.py#L768-L785)
- Notice delivery signals restore the propagated trace context before applying delivery or failure state. [polis/src/polis/queue/inbound.pyL698-L712](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/0041fbc901f3efa35a390c14271a6d9055b7f263/polis/src/polis/queue/inbound.py#L698-L712)
- A failed keyed relay hands retry custody to the outbox and returns, allowing the results-stream entry to be acknowledged instead of remaining pending. [polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.pyL888-L905](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/0041fbc901f3efa35a390c14271a6d9055b7f263/polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.py#L888-L905)
- Reclaimed keyed notice entries are retired to the authoritative outbox rather than replayed independently. [polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.pyL691-L729](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/0041fbc901f3efa35a390c14271a6d9055b7f263/polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.py#L691-L729)
- The retry-owner predicate remains narrow: unkeyed relays and compositions without a nacker retain stream-owned retry behavior. [polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.pyL947-L972](https://github.com/Skrates/sokrates/blob/0041fbc901f3efa35a390c14271a6d9055b7f263/polis/src/polis/queue/sokrates_arc.py#L947-L972)

No repository changes were needed, so no commit or follow-up PR was created.

**Testing**
- ✅ `git diff --check b39047bb..0041fbc9`
- ✅ `uv run pytest -q polis/tests/test_sokrates_arc.py polis/tests/test_act_plane_inbound.py polis/tests/pursuit/test_actions.py polis/tests/pursuit/test_notices_in_memory.py` — 94 passed.
- ✅ `git status --short --branch` — clean working tree at the reviewed head.
